## Checklist

- [ ] I did not add full transcripts, captions, Show Notes, paper PDFs, paywalled text, media, credentials or personal medical information.
- [ ] New health claims include provenance, evidence level, limitations and safe interpretation.
- [ ] New action steps remain within one playbook, use no invented universal dose/timing and include stop/escalation conditions.
- [ ] Schema changes update the data dictionary, exporter, tests and changelog.
- [ ] `python scripts/release_check.py` passes.
- [ ] `python scripts/release_readiness.py` passes.
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes.
- [ ] I reviewed the generated manifest and public payload diff.
